evidence.title: Meeting Scheduling Software and AI Meeting Tools | Calendly

name: Calendly
summary: Scheduling platform for booking links, calendar sync, lead routing, payments and AI meeting notes.
description: Connects to your calendars, video conferencing and CRM so invitees can book without back-and-forth: event types, availability rules, meeting polls, routing forms, website embeds, payment collection and automated reminders. Callie, the AI scheduling assistant, negotiates times by email and in-app chat, and Notetaker records, transcribes and summarizes meetings. Free tier for individuals, paid Standard/Teams plans and enterprise governance.
contains: Free plan: one event type, one calendar connection, one-on-one scheduling
Standard from $10/seat/mo, plus Teams and Enterprise tiers with SSO and SCIM
Callie AI assistant books over email and in-app chat
Notetaker records, transcribes and summarizes meetings
150+ integrations incl. Google, Microsoft, HubSpot and Stripe
Website embeds, routing forms and meeting polls
MCP server for ChatGPT and Claude
